column1: # 1A dropped-delta ledger (PLAN.md r46a §3.3): fork-authored behaviour that stone-1a does not keep. An entry is
# "superseded by upstream" only when it names the superseding upstream commit and that commit is an ancestor of
# 74d0c72fd (§2.2.6); otherwise "fork behaviour removed", with a reason. Started in 1A.1 with the entries the lead's
# decisions created; 1A.6 completes it over the whole fork delta (the independent 1A.1 review found no unexplained drop:

column3: +ssh-cache: the fork's list ("Cached hosts (N):" and "host (N days ago)", saturating age), its help saying entries never expire, --add/--remove/--clear success messages, exit 1 for an invalid destination, --host as the query flag, and DiskCache's AddResult/add(alloc, hostname)
column4: superseded by upstream: the rework lists "dest  YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (2w ago)" and nothing when empty; --add, --remove and --clear are silent on success; a no-op --remove exits 1; an invalid destination exits 2; --host=X still works (0 on a match, 1 on none) but warns on stderr and prints the match; a bare host matches every user on it; new positional destination and --prune=<duration>. The fork's portable cache path (PKG-61), actionpkg.help_error, noctty branding and its accurate help paragraph are re-applied
column8: 1A.8 release notes: the changed list format and exit codes. Shell integrations: elvish moved to the positional form in 8c86b928d (it showed stderr); bash, zsh, fish, nushell and PowerShell discard stderr and move in Phase 3 (row 14)
